test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed079e56f511f2b5119275a9e92435a276e76a0481cf64928e701f0f5d0e1235.png] 

Logic:** 1st letter - 3 = 2nd letter**

**2nd letter + 4 = 3rd letter.**

Option 1) VSW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e805b32ed2b44b5caebbdcd7c124f540fd4f62517773dc5ddaa2e799cf28c745.png] 

Option 2) WTX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a901d538f356573a6c590c820a543cca99110ede278207f051e439adbec515db.png] 

**Option 3) NLO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d6302b7fa97e0886bc51f85e0f45cdc1bdb070a52b88d7264cdb98246cd8f72.png] 

Option 4) KHL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95a29daac0f0fd2cfe044c3733d440f5d0e1fe426f8c83247f07b7f8408784e8.png] 

Thus, Option 3 not follow the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
